title: HealthSense Assistant
subtitle: Ask about your measurements, consultations, workouts, nutrition, or how to use the app
placeholder: Type your question… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
welcome: Hi! I am the HealthSense assistant. I can read your own data to answer, for example:

suggestions.workout: How many minutes did I work out this week?
suggestions.consultation: Do I have any upcoming consultation?
suggestions.navigate: Where do I change my password?

disclaimer: The assistant supports screening and guidance only; it does not replace a doctor's diagnosis. In an emergency call 115.

errors.stream: The assistant ran into a problem, please try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired, please sign in again.
